correctness.rationale: The normalized gaps have Dirichlet(1,...,1) law. The one-gap moments are s_n and a_n; product-to-sum gives h_n; conditioning on T=Y_1+Y_2 and the uniform split U gives d_n. Exchangeability yields E[P_n A_n]=n h_n+n(n-1)d_n and E[P_n]E[A_n]=n^2 s_n a_n. Integration-by-parts recurrences terminate, and exact n=3 and n=4 values were symbolically checked. No full joint law or all-n sign theorem is asserted.
